title: Kianmhz/GooseRelayVPN
claim: Kianmhz/GooseRelayVPN — SOCKS5 VPN that tunnels raw TCP through Google Apps Script to a VPS exit server, with end-to-end AES-256-GCM and domain-
why_good: The use of Google Apps Script for tunneling provides a unique way to bypass traditional VPN restrictions, making it appealing for users in restrictive environments.
value: Businesses and individuals seeking secure, uncensored internet access would pay for subscription plans, especially in regions with heavy internet censorship.
risk: The project may struggle to scale as a business if larger VPN providers integrate similar features or if Google restricts the use of their Apps Script for such purposes.
pick_reason: The project offers a unique VPN solution that can be monetized by providing secure access to users in restrictive environments.
